problem.title: 2D Prefix Sum Matrix
problem.problemStatement: Given an N × M integer matrix, construct its 2D prefix sum matrix. Each cell (i, j) in the prefix matrix should store the sum of all elements in the rectangle from (0,0) to (i,j).
problem.input: Integer N Integer M Matrix grid
